criteria.label: Value proposition
criteria.instructions: How clear is the main value proposition?

criteria.label: Problem
criteria.instructions: Does the copy name a concrete user problem?

criteria.label: Proof
criteria.instructions: Does the text provide evidence for its claims?

criteria.label: Social proof
criteria.instructions: Does the text contain customer or adoption evidence?

criteria.label: Call to action
criteria.instructions: How clear and actionable is the primary call to action?

criteria.label: Risk reversal
criteria.instructions: Does the copy reduce perceived risk?

criteria.label: Low jargon
criteria.instructions: How free is the text from unexplained jargon?

criteria.label: Scannability
criteria.instructions: How easy is the copy to scan?

criteria.label: Differentiation
criteria.instructions: Does the text state why this differs from alternatives?

criteria.label: Credibility
criteria.instructions: How credible are the stated claims?
